body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'Surfaces 2009') -- <Visual News> Torlys officially launched its eco-engineered flooring 'TerraWood' at Surfaces 2009 in Las Vegas. The floor will be available to TORLYS dealers in the United States and Canada.

TerraWood is a patented, all-wood product, made with recycled wood from every part of the tree including bark and branches. Production is efficient and the eco-innovation is remarkable: TerraForma technology uses every wood element to retain the rich, warm look and feel of hardwood while creating an incredibly durable finish that is harder than many hardwoods.

TerraWood is TORLYS' latest development in eco-engineered flooring, designed for today's active families. Its durability makes it a great choice for any room in the house, particularly family and living rooms, kitchens, playrooms, laundry rooms and basements.
Formaldehyde free, TerraWood is created to preserve indoor air quality at levels well within the E1 (European Union) and California (Public School 01350) Indoor Air Quality and CARB standards.

Available in a collection of 16 domestic and exotic species with style names such as Kinabalu Teak, Whistler Oak and Innsbruck Cherry - TerraWood is also backed with a layer of recycled cork, a naturally cushioned insulator that precludes the need for an underlay.
